en: Black‑and‑white image of a long, two‑storey wooden building with vertical cladding and many tall windows. The structure stands in a landscaped area with young trees and a dirt path in the foreground. Several men in light trousers and darker jackets walk or stand near the building, while others look out from open windows on the upper floor. One person in a darker uniform or coat strolls alone on the path. The scene feels like a hospital, sanatorium, or institutional dormitory in a park‑like setting. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the image side.
